Brief agreement, rejection and critical discussion can qualify. A matched or inherited quotation alone does not. Excerpts label the quoted passage separately from the current response and use exact source slices. This is one-reviewer qualitative selection assisted by structural rules; remaining ambiguous associations can be checked against the linked full posts. The original 723 message records and EML files remain preserved as archival sources.
